Bird Translation AI · diagnostic

Can you hear the difference?

The classifier confuses robin alarm and call almost symmetrically — 101 errors one way, 109 the other. That pattern usually means the two categories overlap in reality, not that the model is failing. This test settles it: if a human listener can't separate them either, the distinction isn't real and we should merge the labels.
